standard_prerequisites.name: Definition of a divided power structure
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies axioms (1)-(5) used throughout all four parts.

core_obligations: Prove (1): n! gamma_n(x) = x^n from axiom (2) applied to (1, n-1) plus induction.
Deduce (2) uniqueness when A is torsionfree from (1).

Prove (3): for torsionfree A, gamma is a divided power structure iff n! gamma_n(x) = x^n for all x, n -- embed A in A tensor Q, verify the axioms for x^n/n! there (axiom (4) displayed as the binomial formula), then transport back.

Prove (4): I admits a divided power structure iff some ideal generating set x_i satisfies x_i^n in (n!)I for all n -- extend to all x in I by induction on expression length and the binomial theorem, then set gamma_n(x) = x^n/n! and invoke (3).
proof_roadmap: Run the four-part argument: axiom-(2) induction for (1); Q-algebra embedding for (3) with the binomial-formula verification displayed; generator-to-element extension for (4) via the binomial theorem.
difficulty_reason: Four interlocking parts forming the torsionfree foundation of the whole chapter; part (3) needs the Q-algebra reduction executed and part (4) the generator extension induction.
